VP-WF-003.remediation: Forbid invented ledger states and prevent absence-of-registry-match from being promoted to proof of falsity.

VP-WF-006.remediation: Treat self-reported background as context only and require observed retrieval/application or explicit assessment evidence before RECALLABLE/APPLICABLE/TRANSFERABLE.

closure_rule: All 4 cases must PASS on each host/config used for requalification.
VP-WF-003 certification-registry absence must not be described as proof of falsity unless completeness/direct disproof is actually established.
VP-WF-003 ledger must use only configured states.
VP-WF-006 may not initialize self-reported knowledge above FRAGILE without supplied assessment evidence.
Exact UI model/config metadata must be captured for each host.

gate_effect.exact_asset_runtime: A qualifying ChatGPT delta run re-establishes current-blob runtime coverage for the changed assets in the v1 exact-asset gate.
gate_effect.portability: Qualifying runs on both ChatGPT and Gemini re-establish behavioral coverage for the changed assets. Full named-host/model portability still requires the previous 12-case runs to have recoverable exact model metadata; otherwise rerun the full 12-case batch with metadata.
